query.text: 我是街道巡查人员，请帮我留意路口，听到警报声或看到执行任务的应急车辆接近时及时告诉我，车辆驶过后也请通知我。
query.text_en: I am inspecting the street. Please monitor the intersection, tell me when you hear a siren or see an emergency vehicle approaching on duty, and also notify me after it passes.

annotation.text_zh: 有应急车辆鸣笛并闪灯接近路口。
annotation.text_en: An emergency vehicle is approaching the intersection with a siren and flashing lights.

annotation.text_zh: 消防车已驶过，正在远去。
annotation.text_en: The fire engine has passed and is moving away.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
